comment: ANCHOR: SHARED_OUTPUT_RECEIPTS_20261108 — LQ-20261107-1058 (G3 repair): the manifest names two ACTIVE rows for one
systemd unit (DUPLICATE_UNIT_ROW, error) and one output proving several lanes (SHARED_OUTPUT_SIGNAL, warn); the
